body: - 2026-11-18: A test-support helper in a crate's `src/` (the live rig's version probe among them) that spawns an instrumented binary under `env_clear()` runs it with a scratch directory as its cwd, or re-adds `LLVM_PROFILE_FILE`: under `cargo llvm-cov` a child left without it writes `default_*.profraw` into its inherited cwd, and the next tree-status assertion reads the tree moved. The rule above holds there too, though this file does not load on `src/`.
- 2026-11-18: an instrumented child spawned under `env_clear()` from `src/` (`testing.md`, the entry of that date).

It added a hidden rig-only verify option, absent from --help, that on a failed recording verify writes each non-box run's first screen as whole rows passed through the fixture scrub and refused whole when any row is unclean; a plain record and a passing verify write no such file.
The cause of runs B to F stopping short of the input box was named as claude's browser-tools prompt; only the rig was mended, its seed now carrying five bundle keys including the browser-tools key, and viola verify and viola run are unchanged for that prompt, which becomes its own route entry.
The verify-window test-class kill moved from 60 s to 80 s; a red under coverage, stray coverage profiles from the version probe run in the test cwd, was fixed by running the probe in the scratch root.
The relied ledger row count stays 23; no capability is claimed and no CLI output line, refusal, exit code or help line of a served verb changed.

body: No screen-content parsing beyond signatures: the first-screen classifier and its row facts read only compiled literal ids and closed row families, but the rig-only failed-verify record now writes whole scrubbed rows of the child screen to a local file, an exception the founder answered himself.

Boundary check never inspects claude content and the single vendor-content boundary: the hidden failed-verify first-screen record copies vendor screen rows out, rig-only and local, through the scrub and a whole-set refusal; a picker should judge whether those rows need the exception beside them.
Paths not carried: the first-screen record rewrites the home path in its rows and keeps a temp path, through the fixture scrub.
viola --help served verbs only and the usage line: the new verify option is hidden and absent from --help, pinned by a case that help names no first-screens option.
Critical path verify output and the verify step line: viola verify's printed output is unchanged; only the stamp's measured block and the hidden record file gained content.
viola verify interrupted, its exit and stderr pair: a stopped verify with record writes no first-screen file, a new case beside those contracts.
Live readings never gate: the S0B reading of 23/23 on 2.1.325 is a live rig reading, recorded and not a gate.

Time bounds fall on the driver only and no harsh timeouts: the verify-window test-class kill moved from 60 s to 80 s, a test-harness bound and not one on the human; a row stating sixty seconds for it would be stale.

A11y cases run inside the coverage suite and gate requires coverage: a red read only under coverage, profiles written into a test cwd by an instrumented child, was fixed; the coverage gate itself is unchanged.
Control characters escaped: the first-screen rows go out as JSON after the scrub and the screen-fault check, not printed to the terminal.
Wheel and human-keystroke rows: the browser-tools prompt is now named as a modal claude raises; viola run's pre-send gate is unchanged for it and the gap is a route entry, not built here.

body:
The relied trust-record ledger row was read live on claude 2.1.325 in the standing live rig (start S0B) and passed 23/23, so the row is now verified on 2.1.325 under the rig's private config only; nothing is claimed for 2.1.326 or 2.1.327.
The cause that stopped verify's interactive runs B to F short of the input box was measured: 2.1.325's browser-tools prompt (ChromeAutoEnableDialog), not the first-run config and not trust.
viola verify now reads and stamps each interactive run's first screen: the stamp's measured gains closed first-screen words, whole-number settle walls and closed row facts (literal ids, rule above prompt, first-row family, last column), with no screen text.
A hidden rig-only verify option (--record-first-screens) writes, on a failed record verify only, one local first-screen file of whole scrubbed rows per run that missed the box; an unclean set is refused whole; a plain record and a passing verify write no such file; it is absent from help.
The rig's seed moved from six used-config markers to five bundle keys (including claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled false), the rig gained the VC arm, S0B labels and new summary lines, and its version probe now runs in the scratch root so no coverage profile lands in the tree.
The verify-window nextest class kill moved 60 s to 80 s in the ci and mutants profiles; viola run and the browser-tools prompt as a modal are unchanged and become a new route entry.

body: The rows that verify lines carry no content and that no telemetry comes from screen content: verify now classifies each run's first screen and stamps closed words and closed facts from it; the stamp is no log line, but a picker must check these rows still hold and say so.

The rows that recorded Claude fixtures are scrub-required and that fixtures are no telemetry source: a new rig-only first-screen file of whole scrubbed rows is recorded beside the fixtures, scrubbed and refused whole when unclean, and kept local.

The rows that the capability ledger path and stamps are never logged and that verify is the only stamps writer: the stamp's measured gains first_screen, first_settle_ms and first_facts, still written by verify alone.

The rows that CI verifies against the fake agent only and that real-CLI verify never runs in CI: the trust-record row was verified live on 2.1.325 in the rig, outside CI, and CI still ran on the fake.

The rows that the PTY byte stream and typed keys are never logged: verify's typed runs now keep their first settled rows in memory and the rig prints first-screen words and facts; no key was typed on any live start.
The rows on the trust-record write staying uninstrumented and an unreadable ledger counting as unverified: the trust-record row is now verified on 2.1.325, with its writer unchanged.

The verify stdout step and summary line contracts and verify exit codes: the summary still reads the relied row count of 23; a picker should confirm no verify stdout or exit shape changed (only a hidden option was added, absent from help).

The verify child spawn subject version-probe: the rig's own version probe now runs with the scratch root as its working directory, so an instrumented child's coverage profile no longer lands in the tree.

The rows that test homes are kept until gates run and that test homes live under the scanned root, and the secret-scan scope: the rig rehearsal's no-credential and no-host-path record check read red on stray coverage profiles and was fixed by the probe's working directory.
Any row whose cell holds the verify-window test class kill timeout: it moved from 60 s to 80 s in the ci and mutants nextest profiles.

The row that wrapped claude internals are not a contract and that transcripts are not a contract: the 2.1.325 bundle's browser-tools prompt and its config key were read from the bundle and used only as the rig's seed.

The rows on the closed event enum and closed detail words: the new first-screen words (trust, imports, box, none, exited) and row families (rule, banner, text) are closed kebab-case words in the stamp, not log events.

body_fields.fact: The rig-only hidden verify first-screen record (whole scrubbed rows of each run that missed the box, written only on a failed record verify, refused whole when unclean, kept local and git-ignored) is a fixture-side record, never a telemetry source and never a log line.
The stamp's measured first-screen words, settle walls and row facts are closed words, whole numbers and literal ids only, hold no screen text, and are never logged like the rest of the ledger stamps.

The session read the relied trust-record ledger row live on claude 2.1.325 in the live rig's private home: start S0B passed 23/23, so the row is verified on 2.1.325 under the rig only, and nothing is claimed for 2.1.326 or 2.1.327.

verify gains a hidden rig-only option. On a failed recording verify it writes each failed run's first screen as whole scrubbed rows, refuses an unclean set whole, keeps the files local and git-ignored, and leaves it out of help. The founder answered this widening in his own words.

The verify window class kill in the test runner moved from 60 s to 80 s. The relied ledger row count stays 23.

body: decision/live-rig-isolated-child: the rig child's seed now holds five keys taken from the bundle's own logic, none from the founder's config. Four are used-config markers and one is the browser-tools key set to false. The rig also writes git's minimal layout into its private scratch without spawning a process.

decision/verify-signature-only and decision/verify-reads-only-signatures: these gain an exception. A hidden rig-only option on a failed recording verify keeps whole scrubbed rows of each failed run's first screen.

decision/verify-screen-read-against-literals and decision/input-box-readiness-from-literals: the first-screen classifier reads only compiled literals (trust, imports, box, none, exited), modal before box, and the whole-row record is the exception.

decision/fixture-scrub-and-refusal, decision/fixture-recording-scrubbed and decision/fixture-hygiene: the first-screen files go through the same scrub, every row and seam is checked by the screen-fault check, and an unclean set is refused whole.
decision/screen-fixture-signature-rows-only: the hidden first-screen record keeps whole rows, not only signature rows. It is rig-only, local and never committed.
decision/live-session-screens-kept-local and decision/fixtures-reviewed-before-commit: kept first screens stay local, and their pattern is git-ignored under the fixtures.

contract/verify-refusal-codes/unclean-fixture, contract/fixture-refusal-line/form and the contract/fixture-refusal-codes rows (absolute-path, email, home-path, username): the first-screen record's whole-set refusal goes through the same refusal path.

decision/stamps-written-only-by-verify and decision/trust-record-closed-words: verify's stamp gains measured first-screen words, settle walls and fact rows, holding closed words, whole numbers and literal ids only and no screen text.

decision/test-seams-compiled-out, decision/test-seams-fake-agent-only and decision/new-env-read-needs-log-entry: verify gains a hidden option that is absent from help and passed only by the rig's V arm. It is not compiled out of release.

decision/controls-not-switchable and decision/no-control-switch-off: the hidden option widens what verify records. It switches no scrub or refusal off, and a plain recording or a passing verify writes no screen.

decision/verify-never-answers-dialogs and decision/verify-writes-no-dialog-byte: the browser-tools prompt is a dialog that verify does not yet read as a modal. verify still answers nothing, and the rig avoids the prompt through its seed key.

decision/live-round-rig-keys-own-pty and decision/live-rig-prompt-capture-closed: a new VC arm reads its first frame at 80x24 and stops with no key. Every start held keys none, and the new summary lines print closed words, numbers and literal ids.
decision/live-rig-credentials-copy: the rig's isolation module changed. The teardown still removed the credentials and left the scratch absent.

decision/nothing-written-under-claude-home, decision/no-writes-under-claude-home and decision/viola-writes-nothing-in-claude-dir: the rig, not viola, writes the child's config seed and git layout, and only inside its private scratch.
decision/bounded-readers-census, decision/reads-capped-at-max-frame and decision/max-frame-cap: the rig adds a JSON file reader bounded at MAX_FRAME.

decision/trust-record-writer-guarded, decision/verify-never-answers-import and decision/verify-trusted-runs-risk: the trust-record row is now verified live on 2.1.325 under the rig's private config, so any wording that says the row is unverified on the real CLI is stale. A live home still needs its own live verify.
decision/real-cli-local-only and decision/verify-children-direct-spawn: the rig's version probe now runs with the scratch as its cwd, so an instrumented child leaves no profile files in the tree.
decision/test-homes-gitignored and decision/no-secrets-in-git: the git ignore list gains the first-screen file pattern under the fixtures.

body: decision/verify-window-60s-kill names a 60 s kill for the verify_window_ class; the kill is now 80 s in the ci and mutants profiles, with measured walls, so the row's value and its title are stale.

Kill-line ordering rows (kill lines below cargo-mutants' timeout, root waits bounded below the kills, the per-test kill for verify-driven tests) rule over the moved 80 s verify_window_ kill and must still hold against it.

decision/standing-live-rig gains: the V arm stands its scratch as a git root spawning nothing; it prints screen words, settle walls, facts, the relied row count and the failing ids; its seed carries the used-config markers and prints seed-markers; the VC arm; the record copy and kept line; the S0B and S0B-2 labels and the browser-tools key.

decision/live-failing-reading-not-verification: the RED rig starts are kept as read; S0B is the live verification of the trust-record row on 2.1.325 under the rig's private config, and nothing is claimed for 2.1.326 or 2.1.327.

Fixture recording rows (fixtures recorded only when nothing fails, recorder scrubs home paths and usernames, dirty payload refuses the recording, fixtures refreshed by live verify) gain an exception: a hidden rig-only flag makes a FAILED recording verify write first-screen files of whole scrubbed rows, refused whole when any row or seam is unclean, kept local and gitignored; a plain record verify and a passing verify write none.

decision/screen-fixture-box-rows-as-literals and decision/screen-fixture-scrub-as-detector: the rig-only first-screen record keeps whole rows, not box literals alone, scrubbed and checked by the screen fault check.

Screen-reading rows (screen read only for compiled signatures, no assertion beyond compiled literals, rendered child screen never parsed, no assertions on the child's screen) rule over verify's new first-screen classifier, which reads only compiled signatures and records closed words, whole numbers and literal ids, never screen text.
decision/closed-enums-need-decisions-log rules over the new closed word sets: the first-screen words trust, imports, box, none, exited and the row families rule, banner, text.

Stamp rows (stamps written only by verify, verify is the only stamp writer, single writers of snapshot and stamps) rule over the stamp's measured block, which verify now extends with first_screen, first_settle_ms and first_facts.

decision/verify-takes-no-json and the viola verify output contracts: verify gains a hidden option absent from its help, passed only by the rig's V arm; no step line, summary line or exit detail changed.

Profile rows (env_clear tests re-add LLVM_PROFILE_FILE, cleared environment keeps LLVM_PROFILE_FILE, profraw census is a dev-host tool, child viola processes counted in coverage) are reached by the pre-push red: a version probe spawning the instrumented fake agent under a cleared environment wrote coverage profiles into the test's cwd; the fix runs the probe in the scratch root.

decision/fake-agent-not-proof-of-real-cli: the step 15 fake-agent oracle premise that runs B to F read a rule above the prompt was measured false (the fake draws none); the real-CLI claim rests on the live S0B start.

Version-gate rows (version gate needs every relied row, unverified CLI version gate, compatibility tests across CLI versions, every ledger row has a verify probe): the relied row count stays 23 and the trust-record row's probe now passes live on 2.1.325; the 2.1.325 recorded fixture set still needs a live verify in a live home.

Real-CLI locality rows (real claude CLI tested local-only, live verify never in CI, CI never touches the real agent CLI, tests never read the host's claude sessions) rule over the live rig starts and its private config seed, whose five keys come from the bundle's own logic and none from the founder's config.

Tied verify start rows (every test verify start tied to a test-owned home, test verifies run under a test-owned user home, one shared copy of each test helper) rule over the shared verify start helper, which now takes a place record instead of three parameters.
Fixture hygiene walk rows (fixture hygiene run-time walk, fixture hygiene walk) may meet the new gitignored first-screen files under the claude fixtures on a dev host after a failed rig verify.

body_fields.fact: A failed recording verify run by the live rig alone writes one first-screen file of whole scrubbed rows per run not reaching the input box (Run A's trust screen excepted), refused whole when unclean, gitignored and never committed; no other verify writes it.
A test probe that spawns an instrumented binary under a cleared environment runs with a scratch directory as its cwd, so no coverage profile lands in the tree.
The trust-record relied ledger row is verified live on claude 2.1.325 only, by rig start S0B under the rig's private config; no later CLI version is claimed.
